help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Nshobora kubika amafoto bwite?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: Kugira ngo ukurikirane impinduka zimwe zigaragara.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Yego. Amafoto bwite arinzwe arahari, urugero kugira ngo ukurikirane uko ibiheri, imbyiro cyangwa ibimenyetso byo ku ruhu bihinduka.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: AWA irinda ite amakuru yanjye?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Ubuzima bwite, umutekano no gukusanya make.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: AWA yubakiye ku gukusanya amakuru make, nta matangazo agamije abantu runaka, nta kugurisha amakuru bwite, no kuyabika mu buryo bwizewe hakoreshejwe ibanga nyaryo ku makuru y’ingenzi.
help.faq.security-export.question: Nshobora gusohora amakuru yanjye?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: PDF na CSV birashoboka.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Yego. Hari PDF y’ibyo ukurikirana na CSV y’amakuru yawe, bityo ushobora kubaka amateka asobanutse, harimo no kuyaha umuganga.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Nshobora gusiba amakuru yanjye byoroshye?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Gusiba biguma byoroshye kandi bigerwaho.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Yego. Gusiba byoroheje amakuru yawe na konti yawe birahari mu igenamiterere rijyanye na byo.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Gutangira gukoresha AWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Menya ahabanza, kalendari, ikayi, intego n’ibimenyetso by’imyemerere.
help.guides.cycle.title: Gukurikirana imihango
help.guides.cycle.text: Andika imihango yawe, ingano y’amaraso, ugenzure ibiteganyijwe ku kwezi kwawe.
help.guides.conceive.title: Kugerageza gusama
help.guides.conceive.text: Kurikirana uburumbuke, ovulation, ubushyuhe bw’umubiri butuje, ururenda n’ibizamini bya LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Kuboneza urubyaro
help.guides.contraception.text: Genzura uburyo ukoresha, ibyibutsa, ibyo wibagiwe n’amateka y’ibyo wanyoye.
help.guides.irregular.title: Imihango idahuye / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Reba imihango idahuye, ibiheri, imbyiro, ibiro n’ibindi bimenyetso bifitanye isano.
help.guides.menopause.title: Mbere yo gucura / Gucura
help.guides.menopause.text: Kurikirana ubushyuhe bwinshi bwihuta, ibitotsi, umunaniro, imitekerereze n’ubuvuzi bwa hormone.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Gukurikirana inda
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Kurikirana itariki yo kubyara, ibyumweru, gahunda, ibizamini n’ibimenyetso.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Nyuma yo kubyara
help.guides.postpartum.text: Kurikirana lochia, isubira ry’ukwezi, konsa, ibitotsi, imitekerereze no gukira.
help.guides.loss.title: Nyuma yo gukurizamo inda
help.guides.loss.text: Kurikirana amaraso, ibimenyetso n’isubira ry’ukwezi kwawe ku muvuduko wawe.
help.guides.calendar.title: Gukoresha kalendari
help.guides.calendar.text: Sobanukirwa imihango, ibiteganyijwe, ibimenyetso n’uburyo bwo kwerekana Gregori / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Kuzuza ikayi ya buri munsi
help.guides.journal.text: Andika ibimenyetso, imitekerereze, ibitotsi, imyitozo, inyandiko n’ubuhehere.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Gukoresha ibimenyetso by’imyemerere
help.guides.spiritual.text: Menya kalendari ya Hijri, isuku, isengesho, igisibo, qadaa na nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Ubuzima bwite n’amakuru
help.guides.privacy.text: Genzura umutekano, uburyo bw’ibanga, gusohora amakuru, ibanga n’gusiba amakuru.
help.helpSupport.title: Ubufasha n’inkunga
help.helpSupport.subtitle: Ufite ikibazo? Turi hano ku bwawe.
help.helpSupport.supportText: Hitamo uburyo bwo kuduhamagara bukubereye, cyangwa urebe ibisubizo bikunze kubazwa.
help.helpSupport.guidesSubtitle: Menya ubuyobozi bwacu kugira ngo ubone akamaro kenshi muri AWA.
help.helpSupport.feedbackSubtitle: Dusangize ibitekerezo byawe kugira ngo dutezimbere porogaramu.
help.helpSupport.bugReportSubtitle: Menyesha ikosa cyangwa imikorere itari yitezwe.
help.helpSupport.modal.errorEmpty: Sobanura icyo usaba mbere yo gukomeza.
help.faqScreen.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
help.faqScreen.intro: Shaka ibisubizo by’ingenzi kugira ngo ukoreshe AWA utuje.
help.guidesScreen.title: Ubuyobozi n’amasomo
help.guidesScreen.intro: Inama zoroshye zo kubona akamaro kenshi muri AWA.
help.whatsNewScreen.title: Ibishya
help.whatsNewScreen.heading: AWA ikomeza gutera imbere
help.whatsNewScreen.body: Nta nyandiko zemewe z’ivugurura ziratunganywa. Ivugurura rizaza rizagaragara hano nirimara gutangazwa.

Menya ibimenyetso bifatika, kandi umenye igihe cyo kubiganiriza umuntu mukuru.

Pad, imyenda y’imbere y’imihango, tampon: sobanukirwa amahitamo hakurikijwe uko wumva woroherewe.
library.articles.firstperiod-gerer-quoti: Uko wagenzura imihango yawe ya mbere buri munsi
Ishuri, siporo, ibitotsi: imigenzo mike yoroshye yo kuguma woroherewe.
library.articles.firstperiod-cycle-irreg: Imihango yanjye ya mbere ntihuye: ni ibisanzwe?

Ibisubizo byoroshye ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku mihango ya mbere.

library.articles.flow-colors-textures.su: Ibara n’uko amaraso y’imihango yawe angana bivuga byinshi ku buzima bwa hormone zawe.
library.articles.symptoms-reconnaitre.su: Amabere arimo ububabare, kubyimba mu nda, umunaniro: aho bituruka.
library.articles.fertility-fenetre-ferti: Impamvu iminsi 6 ikikije ovulation ari yo ifite agaciro kenshi mu gusama.
library.articles.ovulation-comprendre-ov: Igihe cy’ingenzi cy’ukwezi kwawe, n’uko wakibona.
library.articles.pain-gerer-douleurs.sum: Ubushyuhe, kwimuka buhoro, ibyo urya: imigenzo ifasha koko.
library.articles.hydration-bien-shydrate: Kunywa amazi ahagije mu kwezi kose
Impamvu kunywa amazi menshi bigabanya kubyimba mu nda mbere y’imihango.
Impamvu ibitotsi byawe bihinduka hakurikijwe icyiciro cy’ukwezi, no mu gihe cyo gucura.
library.articles.mood-humeur-et-hormones: Impamvu imitekerereze yawe ihinduka mu kwezi kose no mu buzima.
library.articles.basaltemp-suivre-temper: Uburyo bworoshye bwo kwemeza ko ovulation yabaye.

library.articles.nutrition-conception-fe: Intungamubiri zifasha ukwezi kwiza kw’uburumbuke n’inda nzima.
library.articles.conceptiontips-essayer-: Ibimenyetso by’ingenzi byo gutangira urugendo rwawe rwo gusama utuje.
library.articles.conceptiontips-comprend: Ibibaho hagati yo gusama n’ikizamini cyerekana ko utwite.
library.articles.conceptiontips-hygiene-: Imigenzo yoroshye ishobora gufasha urugendo rwawe, nta gihato.

Ikinini, icyomekwa, impeta, implant, IUD ya hormone: ibitandukanya.
library.articles.missedpills-que-faire-e: Icyo gukora giterwa cyane n’igihe gishize wibagiwe.
library.articles.sideeffects-reconnaitre: Ibisanzwe kandi bitagira ingaruka, n’ibigomba gutuma witonda.
library.articles.pcos-comprendre-sopk.su: Indwara y’intanga ngore zifite utubyimba twinshi (PCOS) isobanuwe neza: icyo ari cyo, uko itandukana hagati y’umugore n’undi, n’aho wamenyera byinshi.
library.articles.pcos-cycle-ovulation-fe: Ukwezi, ovulation n’uburumbuke mu gihe ufite PCOS
Impamvu ukwezi kudahuye mu gihe ufite PCOS, n’icyo bivuze ku buruburumbuke.
library.articles.pcos-peau-pilosite-symp: Uruhu, imbyiro n’ibimenyetso bigaragara bya PCOS
Impamvu PCOS ishobora kugira ingaruka ku ruhu no ku mbyiro, n’uko wakwita ku buzima bwawe.
library.articles.pcos-diagnostic-examens: Uko PCOS imenyekana, n’uko wakwitegura gahunda yawe.
library.articles.pcos-poids-metabolisme-: Isano iri hagati ya PCOS, ibiro n’insulin idakora neza, nta guca urubanza cyangwa inzira z’ubusamo.
library.articles.pcos-mode-de-vie-prise-: Amahitamo yo kwita kuri PCOS, n’imigenzo yoroshye yo gushyigikira ubuzima bwawe bwa buri munsi.
library.articles.pcos-acne-hormonale.sum: Impamvu ibiheri bya hormone bishobora kuza mu gihe ufite PCOS, uko wabimenya, n’ibisubizo bishobora gufasha kubigenzura.
library.articles.hormones-menopause-equi: Estrogen, progesterone, FSH, LH: uko zihinduka n’impamvu ibimenyetso bitandukana.
library.articles.exercise-bouger-pour-le: Impamvu kwimuka buri gihe bishobora gushyigikira ukwezi kwawe, ubwoko bw’imyitozo wahitamo, n’uko wahindura umuvuduko nta gihato.
library.articles.exercise-bouger-enceint: Ni iyihe mitsi ikomeza kuba itekanye kandi ifite akamaro.
library.articles.exercise-renforcer-peri: Gukomeza imitsi y’inda y’ibyara nyuma yo kubyara

Icyo iri jambo risobanura ku mubiri, n’uko wakwita ku buzima bwawe.

Ubuvuzi bwa hormone n’ubundi buryo butarimo hormone, mu magambo make.
Incamake yuzuye y’ingingo nyamukuru za fiqh y’abagore, hagati y’imyemerere n’ubuzima bwa buri munsi.
library.articles.menstruationpurity-stat: Gusobanukirwa isano iri hagati y’ukwezi n’isuku y’imyemerere, kugira ngo wite kuri iki gihe ufite ubusobanuro bwisumbuye.

library.articles.fastingqadaa-dispense-e: Uko n’igihe cyo kwishyura iminsi y’igisibo wasimbutse, ku muvuduko wawe kandi nta cyaha mu mutima.
library.articles.prayerduringmenstruatio: Impamvu isengesho ry’imihango rihagarikwa muri iki gihe, n’uko wabaho iki gihe utuje.
library.articles.returningtoprayer-le-gh: Intambwe rusange zo gusubukura isengesho nyuma y’imihango, utuje.
